backend_contract_source.scope: Frontend AuthResponse/reload recovery requires both primitive nonblank strings; no backend schema change.

findings.assessment: Shared hasRequiredTokens requires both primitive string values and rejects blank/whitespace-only strings before either full response or backend fallback can return authenticated credentials. It checks without trimming or otherwise rewriting accepted token bytes.
Backend fallback no longer substitutes an empty refresh token. Successful backend login handler issues both tokens; existing identity consistency and role mapping remain unchanged.

Both supported response shapes exercise missing/null/nonstring/empty/whitespace token values through real authService.login. Actual useLogin tests assert no authenticated state/navigation for malformed replies and successful positive controls; legacy principal-negative tests have valid tokens and still exercise principal checks.

limits: Inspected author tests/types/lint evidence without rerunning; no runtime/API/browser/auth/broker calls performed.
The test-only Wave55 repair and any final hosted/build/image acceptance are separate.
Previous frontend image/browser evidence predates this auth source change; final source needs its own build and required CI.
unchanged_scope: No backend, auth-store, hook, routing, token persistence/refresh architecture or trading code changes in this delta.
Credential validity here is a primitive nonblank representation contract; no JWT signature, expiry or server authorization assurance is inferred.
